summary: Voice input no longer fails silently: a failed recording shows a localized alert next to the mic button, a worklet that does not load is logged with its URL. The mic, stop and retry buttons show icons with localized aria-labels instead of the words mic, stop and retry.
howTo: Tests or CSS that find the voice button by its text 'mic'/'stop'/'retry' now use its aria-label ('Start voice input', 'Stop recording', 'Transcribing…', 'Retry recording'; German in deChatLocale) or [data-component="voice-input-addon"][data-state]. The alert is span[role=alert][data-element="voice-error"] with voiceFailedText or voiceUnavailableText; the recording bar's buttons use voiceCancelAriaLabel and voiceStopAriaLabel. A custom SttProviderAdapter can declare acceptsWorkletUrl and read input.workletUrl in connect(); otherwise voice.workletUrl is ignored for it with a one-time console warning. AudioWorkletLoadError and SttSessionSnapshot.errorCode ('audio-worklet-unavailable') tell the worklet failure apart. VoiceInputButton takes adapter.
